name: Rulka Electricals Ltd.
summary: Rulka Electricals Ltd. is a provider of comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, primarily focusing on the electrical and firefighting sectors in India. The company offers a range of services including electrical contracting for retail, commercial, and industrial projects, data works, turnkey electrical projects, and installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical components like DGs and transformers. Additionally, Rulka Electricals provides commercial electrical services, integrated firefighting solutions, and a newer Solar EPC business. They also handle electrical panels, LT cable laying, energy audits, and HVAC systems. Rulka Electricals operates on a turnkey project model, managing the entire lifecycle from design and material procurement to final testing. Their target markets include industrial, commercial, retail, hospitality, and warehousing sectors across various states in India. The company's industry focus is within the Capital Goods & Industrial Consumables sector, specifically the Electric Equipment segment, and the broader infrastructure solutions sector.
